claim: Patchline ships native ORM plugins wiring Patchline gates into each framework's official migration command. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the native ORM plugins claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make native-orm-plugins-gate`.
